| **W"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"allpaper** | The wallpaper picker in the right column, plus the glass token sheet every panel reads "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"allpaper picker in the right column, plus the glass token sheet every panel reads | `ui-wallpaper` |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Only the `harness` package is a profile layer; the other five are mounted by the rows it patches."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Design"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### The glass shell"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The left column carries identity and navigation (brand wordmark, new-session / launcher,

and a 0.5px outline."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The left column collapses to an icon rail, the right column folds away entirely, and the wallpaper
s"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"hows through underneath."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The right column is a workspace rather than a fixed panel: it can be sessions, it can be wallpaper,
"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"it can be any panel another plugin registers into it (below: a plugin market)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Wallpaper"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The 极境壁纸 panel offers two families: **four procedural fluids** (深海流光, 极光翡翠, 紫晶云海,

| **待办** | Op"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"en to-dos, synced from the right column's to-do panel |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Wallpaper keeps working in immersive mode, with the dashboard over it:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Trending and weather are host-side feeds; to-dos share data with the right column's panel. what is in the packages, what is not."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"You need Node.js, **pnpm**, and the `dsh` CLI (the first command below installs `dsh` if you do not

ha"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s to be on `PATH`; on Windows that is the one piece a fresh Node install leaves out."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"All six packages go in **one** `add`, because only the `harness` package is a profile layer that
mou"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"nts the other five. Installing them one at a time works too, but only the last one is a layer
and th"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"e rest degrade to plain dependencies."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Every command below is written on a single line, so pasting it line by line works exactly as

profile name —"},{"id":"p35s5","text":" pick another if you like."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"### The harness is already installed"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Check the version first:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"If it matches, install — exactly as above, minus the harness install:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"**macOS / Linux — `bash`, `zsh`**"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"**Windows — `cmd.exe` and PowerShell**"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"**This UI installs into a profile of its own.** Your existing profile — same plugins, same

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"## What is in the packages, what is not"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"Built against `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2`, verified on `0.1.6-alpha.2`."},{"id":"p48s1","text":"A harness release that adds a row occupying one of the seats this UI registers would collide with
